title: Varrio Nuevo Estrada
reason: Not enough sourced facts for 1,000 words. Only 4 pages opened with status OK (Mural Conservancy of Los Angeles, Tell Your True Tale, PBS SoCal, CSULA University Times), and they cover the Estrada Courts housing project and its murals plus one former member's memoir (1973 mural, a 1973 killing at a party, feud with Florencia). None gives the gang's criminal history, court cases, leadership, membership or current status. The gang's criminal activity list and its alliances appear only in Wikipedia, which cannot be cited. Court and official routes were blocked: a 2011 California appellate opinion (leagle.com, 403; web archive unreachable), an LA City Attorney PDF (403), LA gang-injunction PDFs (404), a LA County Library page (404). Searches for federal or state cases naming VNE returned none that matched. Conflict to note for any later attempt: the memoir spells the gang Varrio Nueva Estrada; the Wikipedia page spells it Varrio Nuevo Estrada.
